## Description

Move close_batch into `se_workflow` and expose `bin/se-workflow close-batch` with the same flags, NDJSON output, and exit codes as `scripts/close_batch.py`.

## Approach

1. Move logic to `se_workflow/close_batch.py` (or equivalent package module).
2. Add `close-batch` subparser in `se_workflow/cli.py` (`--input`, `--out`, `--cwd`).
3. Update `tests/test_close_batch.py` to drive the CLI entry (`bin/se-workflow close-batch` or `python -m se_workflow.cli close-batch`).
4. Delete `scripts/close_batch.py` or leave a one-line redirect; prefer delete to avoid a second entry.
